messages.content:
hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?

yo... "idk" isn't a name unless your parents were really creative

look, i get it. random person on the internet asking for your name feels weird. but here's the thing - i can't find you jobs if i don't know who you are

i'm not collecting data to sell or spam you. i'm here to get you better opportunities. but i need to know who i'm working with

so... what should i call you?
